subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw core recognize `openclaw-even-g2-node` with signed `platform: "even-hub"` and `deviceFamily: "glasses"` as a canonical native setup-code bootstrap client eligible for the existing bounded operator handoff?
rationale: The code path is small and tested, but it changes a Gateway auth trust boundary and creates a durable wire-level identity for an external glasses app, which automation cannot approve on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve narrow identity after rebase
options.body: Accept the proposed id and metadata contract, require the conflict to be resolved, and leave full app placement and command policy to the related issue.

options.title: Rename or generalize first
options.body: Ask the contributor to switch to a maintainer-preferred durable Even Hub family id and refresh the external app/proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the core slice paused
options.body: Do not add a core bootstrap identity yet and keep Even Hub on generic node/plugin paths until the broader ownership decision is made.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow identity after rebase
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed id and metadata contract, require the conflict to be resolved, and leave full app placement and command policy to the related issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the Gateway auth/protocol and pairing behavior touched by this trust-boundary decision.
